headline: Coding agents eat 41% of dev tooling chatter as Claude 4.7 ships with 1M context
summary: AI coding agents dominated the conversation today, with Claude Sonnet 4.6 multi-agent workflows generating 3.4× normal engagement. Cursor's new 'background agents' beta drew 8,400 mentions in 12 hours — the fastest dev-tool launch since Claude Code last quarter. On the Arabic side, HUMAIN open-sourced its 7B Arabic LLM, triggering an 89% spike in arabic_ai discussion. Funding cooled with only two confirmed rounds, both in voice agents.
watch_tomorrow: OpenAI dev day rumors point to a hosted-agents announcement. Watch @sama and @gdb after 14:00 UTC.
